sentences.text:
This application coming on for admission this day, the court passed the following:
 ORDER

This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail relating to FIR No.320/2018 dated (not mentioned) registered at Police Station Civil Line Satna, District Satna, for the offence under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 read with 34 of the Indian Penal Code.

entities.text: Police Station Civil Line Satna, District Satna
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is in jail since 29.05.2023.

She submits that as per case of prosecution, the complainant in pursuance to a proposal made by the applicant had invested some amount in a Government contract awarded to the applicant but after some time,
it was found that no such contract was ever awarded to the applicant, who on the basis of forged documents convinced the complainant for investing the amount and as such, on the basis of complaint made by the complainant offence got registered against the applicant.

Learned counsel for the applicant submits that it is a completely false allegation whereas the complainant had made Deepak Agrawal vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/93270566/
1 the investment in some other transaction.

entities.text: Deepak Agrawal vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: She further submits that just to implicate the applicant in the alleged offence, an oral allegation was made by the complainant whereas there is nothing in writing to substantiate the allegation made by the complainant.
Even otherwise, she submits that the case is based upon documentary evidence and till now, no such document in favour of the complainant has ever been produced by him.

She submits that the applicant is a permanent resident of Maihar having movable and immovable property and there is no likelihood of his absconding and as such, keeping him behind the bars would not serve any purpose.
She also submits that the applicant is ready to abide by the conditions imposed upon him.
Therefore, she prays that looking to the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and the applicant's custody period, she may be enlarged on bail.
On the other hand, learned Panel Lawyer has opposed the prayer of bail and submitted that looking to the nature of offence committed by the applicant, he is not entitled to be enlarged on bail.

Considering the arguments advanced by learned counsel for the parties and on perusal of case diary,
I am inclined to enlarge the applicant on bail.

Therefore, without commenting anything on the merits of the case, this application is allowed subject to the condition that as and when the presence of applicant is required, he will keep himself available before the Investigating Officer and provide full cooperation in the investigation.

It is directed that the applicant be released on bail upon his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his appearance on the dates given by it.
It is further directed that the applicant shall abide by the conditions enumerated in Section 437(3) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
Certified copy as per rules.

(SANJAY DWIVEDI) JUDGE Devashish DEVASHISH MISHRA 2023.06.19 19:16:46 +05'30'
